text:
Alex K: NovaCorp prep - streaming + function/tool calls with structured JSON, EU residency, CMK KMS. They also asked for a pricing anchor: ~20 concurrent streams, ~3k tokens/request, potential bursts to 40.

Maria S: I'll handle the security questionnaire. Need standard language for where data is stored in Dedicated vs Private.

Devon (SE): We have a Node websocket sample that shows chunked function_call payloads. Quick snippet: ```js
const ws=new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream');
ws.on('open', ()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'start', model:'redwood-stream-1', options:{partial_tool_payload:true}})));
ws.on('message', m=>console.log('delta', m.toString()));
```

Devon (SE): By default SDK buffers until function_call complete; set partial_tool_payload:true to receive incremental args. There is a small CPU overhead; first partials typically appear in 50-200ms.

Raj P: Clarify billing: does streaming change token billing? And recommended Dedicated sizing for steady 20 concurrent 3k-token streams?

Devon (SE): Tokens billed the same. Dedicated allows batching/KV caching to lower effective GPU cost. Recommend a load test (20x3k) to size; rough guess: reserve capacity equivalent to 3-4 medium GPUs with autoscale for bursts, but we'll confirm after test.

Maria S: Boilerplate for questionnaire: "For Dedicated/Private, data stays in the customer's selected region/VPC. We support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). SOC2/ISO artifacts available under NDA. Retention and telemetry controls configurable."

Alex K: Action items: Maria - final questionnaire language; Devon - Node + Go snippets and perf note; Raj - pricing anchor including burst handling; book 30-min kickoff Tue 10am CET.

Devon (SE): I'll post the Go snippet and a small load-test harness EOD. Suggest eng-ml run the 20x3k test.

DeployBot: Runbook created: runbook://nova-poc-1794445555 (access: sales,se,security).

Raj P: I'll draft the procurement anchor and loop in finance/AM. Do we need infra help for EU Dedicated capacity spin-up?

Alex K: Loop in eng-infra if needed. Devon ETA?

Devon (SE): ETA EOD for snippets + harness.

Maria S: I'll post SOC2 link and KMS contacts once infra confirms.

Alex K: Thanks team - I'll send the invite and include this thread in the kickoff doc: https://short.link/nova-kickoff.
